title: A Weekend at the Pool
setting: A large sports centre with a swimming pool and a small shop by the exit.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots)

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan)

sentences.en: Swimming is Ben and Lily's favourite weekend activity.
sentences.zh: 游泳是本和莉莉最喜欢的周末活动。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), now in blue swimming trunks, and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots), now in a yellow swimsuit, jump happily into a big indoor swimming pool.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the children happily jumping into a pool; 'weekend' and 'favourite' can't be shown.

sentences.en: This year, the pool is free for children.
sentences.zh: 今年，这个游泳池对儿童免费。
sentences.scene_prompt: Children, including Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) in swimsuits, run happily past an open gate into a big pool.
sentences.draw_note: Shows children entering the pool; 'free' and 'this year' cannot be shown.

sentences.en: They play in the water for an hour.
sentences.zh: 他们在水里玩了一个小时。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), now in blue swimming trunks, and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots), now in a yellow swimsuit, splash each other and play with a ball in the pool.
sentences.draw_note: Shows them playing in the water; 'for an hour' can't be shown.

sentences.en: In the future, Lily wants to be a swimmer.
sentences.zh: 将来，莉莉想当一名游泳运动员。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots), in a swimsuit and goggles, races hard down a lane of the pool while Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) cheers.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Lily swimming hard; her wish for the future is not shown.

sentences.en: Before they go home, they visit the shop.
sentences.zh: 回家之前，他们去了商店。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) and Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan), all dressed with wet hair, walk into a small shop at the sports centre.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the family, dressed again, going into the shop; 'before they go home' can't be shown.

sentences.en: The shop has sweaters in many different colours.
sentences.zh: 这家店有很多不同颜色的毛衣。
sentences.scene_prompt: Shelves in the small shop are full of sweaters in red, blue, green and yellow.

sentences.en: Ben buys a large white one for his mother.
sentences.zh: 本给妈妈买了一件大号白毛衣。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) proudly holds up a large white sweater for Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan).

sentences.en: Anna keeps it on all the way home.
sentences.zh: 安娜一路上都穿着它回家。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan), now wearing the large white sweater, walks home smiling with Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots).
